## Example Usage - Agentregistry Skill Basic


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {}

resource "google_agent_registry_skill" "default" {
  location     = "global"
  skill_id     = "test-skill"
  display_name = "Test Skill"
  target_state = "TARGET_STATE_DRAFT"
  type         = "SIMPLE"
  scanning_config {
    policy = "DISABLED"
  }
  initial_revision {
    name = "projects/${data.google_project.project.project_id}/locations/global/skills/private-test-skill/revisions/rev-1"
    archive_upload_source {
      archive_content = "UEsDBBQAAAAAAEEQQRBjKl0XOwAAADsAAAAIAAAAU0tJTEwubWQtLS0KbmFtZTogdGVzdC1za2lsbApkZXNjcmlwdGlvbjogVGVzdCBza2lsbAotLS0KIyBUZXN0CnYwClBLAQIUAxQAAAAAAEEQQRBjKl0XOwAAADsAAAAIAAAAAAAAAAAAAQAAAAAAAABTS0lMTC5tZFBLBQYAAAAAAQABADYAAABhAAAAAAA="
    }
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Agentregistry Skill Gcs


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "bucket" {
  name                        = "test-skill-bucket"
  location                    = "US"
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
  force_destroy               = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "p4sa_reader" {
  bucket = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  role   = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-agentregistry.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "object" {
  name    = "skill.zip"
  bucket  = google_storage_bucket.bucket.name
  content = base64decode("UEsDBBQAAAAAAEEQQRBjKl0XOwAAADsAAAAIAAAAU0tJTEwubWQtLS0KbmFtZTogdGVzdC1za2lsbApkZXNjcmlwdGlvbjogVGVzdCBza2lsbAotLS0KIyBUZXN0CnYwClBLAQIUAxQAAAAAAEEQQRBjKl0XOwAAADsAAAAIAAAAAAAAAAAAAQAAAAAAAABTS0lMTC5tZFBLBQYAAAAAAQABADYAAABhAAAAAAA=")
}

resource "google_agent_registry_skill" "default" {
  location     = "global"
  skill_id     = "test-skill-gcs"
  target_state = "TARGET_STATE_DRAFT"
  type         = "SIMPLE"
  description  = "A test skill from GCS"
  display_name = "Test Skill GCS"
  scanning_config {
    policy = "DISABLED"
  }
  initial_revision {
    gcs_source {
      uri        = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.object.name}"
      generation = tostring(google_storage_bucket_object.object.generation)
    }
  }
  depends_on = [google_storage_bucket_iam_member.p4sa_reader]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `target_state` -
  (Required)
  User-managed target state of the skill.
  Possible values:
  TARGET_STATE_DRAFT
  TARGET_STATE_ACTIVE
  TARGET_STATE_DISABLED
  TARGET_STATE_DEPRECATED
  TARGET_STATE_DECOMMISSIONED

* `type` -
  (Required)
  Structural deployment type (SIMPLE leaf vs COMPOSITE bundle).
  Possible values:
  SIMPLE

* `location` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `skill_id` -
  (Required)
  Custom, user-defined unique container identifier.
  Must be unique within the parent project and location.
  This value should be 4-64 characters, and valid characters
  are `/a-z-/`.


* `default_revision` -
  (Optional)
  The full resource name of the revision currently served by
  default (floating track).
  Format:
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/skills/{skill}/revisions/{revision}`

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Brief summary describing the capabilities of the skill.
  Maximum length is 2048 characters.

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Human-readable display name of the skill.
  Maximum length is 128 characters.

* `initial_revision` -
  (Optional)
  Represents an immutable, versioned snapshot of a Skill package.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_initial_revision).

* `scanning_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for scanning of the skill.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_scanning_config).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_initial_revision"></a>The `initial_revision` block supports:

* `archive_upload_source` -
  (Optional)
  Direct write-only raw archive payload upload.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_initial_revision_archive_upload_source).

* `gcs_source` -
  (Optional)
  Specifications for Cloud Storage objects.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_initial_revision_gcs_source).

* `name` -
  (Optional)
  Identifier. Resource name of the SkillRevision.
  Format:
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/skills/{skill}/revisions/{revision}`


<a name="nested_initial_revision_archive_upload_source"></a>The `archive_upload_source` block supports:

* `archive_content` -
  (Required)
  Input only. Write-only raw ZIP/TAR archive payload bytes containing the skill
  package.

<a name="nested_initial_revision_gcs_source"></a>The `gcs_source` block supports:

* `generation` -
  (Optional)
  Cloud Storage object generation ID. If not specified, the latest
  generation is used.

* `uri` -
  (Required)
  Cloud Storage object URI.
  Format:
  `gs://{bucket_name}/{object_name}`

<a name="nested_scanning_config"></a>The `scanning_config` block supports:

* `policy` -
  (Optional)
  The security scanning policy.
  Possible values:
  DISABLED
  ENABLED_BLOCKING
  ENABLED_NONBLOCKING

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/skills/{{name}}`

* `create_time` -
  Create time.

* `frontmatter` -
  Structured metadata attributes extracted from the package's local SKILL.md
  frontmatter.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_frontmatter).

* `name` -
  Identifier. Resource name of the Skill.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/skills/{skill}`
  The `{skill}` segment acts as the resource ID. If the skill is associated
  with a Publisher, this segment typically uses a hyphenated namespace prefix
  corresponding to the publisher (e.g., `google-workspace-create-docs`).

* `publisher` -
  The publisher resource associated with this skill.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/publishers/{publisher}`
  The publisher dictates the allowed namespace prefixes for the skill's name
  and logical `skill_id` (e.g., Publisher `google` authorizes the `google-*`
  prefix).

* `skill_urn` -
  A stable, globally unique logical identifier for the skill.
  It is securely constructed by the backend by combining the associated
  `publisher`'s verified namespace and the skill's resource ID to enforce
  strict ownership. For example, the prefix `google-` is reserved exclusively
  for first-party Google publishers to prevent namespace squatting.
  Example: `urn:skill:google-workspace:create-docs`

* `state` -
  The system-managed state of the skill.
  Possible values:
  STATE_CREATING
  STATE_DRAFT
  STATE_ACTIVE
  STATE_DISABLED
  STATE_DEPRECATED
  STATE_DECOMMISSIONED
  STATE_DELETING

* `uid` -
  Universally unique identifier (UUID4) for the logical
  container.

* `update_time` -
  Update time.


<a name="nested_frontmatter"></a>The `frontmatter` block contains:

* `compatibility` -
  (Output)
  Environmental dependencies or companion services.

* `description` -
  (Output)
  Functional description.

* `license` -
  (Output)
  License.

* `metadata` -
  (Output)
  Extensible flattened map mapping custom tags, authors, and
  version parameters.

* `name` -
  (Output)
  The name of the skill.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Skill can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/skills/{{name}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{name}}`
* `{{location}}/{{name}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Skill using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    name = "<-optional value->"
    location = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_agent_registry_skill.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Skill using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/skills/{{name}}"
  to = google_agent_registry_skill.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Skill can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_skill.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/skills/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_skill.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_skill.default {{location}}/{{name}}
```
